reviews.title: 3 years and still loving it!
reviews.text:
This app has helped me understand what I need to do, to improve my sleep.   I used to suffer from horrible insomnia. Falling asleep and staying asleep were difficult for me. Just making sure that my Apple Watch is charged for bedtime, is one step in choosing to make sleep a priority. 

The stages of sleep are actually important. I’ve learned to follow the advice that the app gives and pay attention to the reminders to go to bed. Keeping a regular sleep schedule, has really paid off. I love knowing what my sleep score is each morning. It is on point!!! 

There are a lot of things to explore in the app. Informational content and guided help to fall asleep, are of the most important to me. Also, the cost is so inexpensive, once a year!  It is an app that everyone should use! 

I’ve shared it with so many friends and family! They were grateful that I shared it with them and are all hooked now! Most importantly, they are experiencing the success that I have found in getting a good nights rest on a regular basis! It has improved my quality of life.

reviews.title: Great, but…
reviews.text:
I liked this app very much at first. It was extremely helpful in recognizing how my sleep is punctuated and the evolving sleep trends. Because I wear a 24/7 electronic device, that was interruptive of the sleep program. Pillow does not seem to adapt to people who nap or to those who have unusual sleep styles. It was just a lot for me. 

I did not ask for help, but I do think this program would be helpful to those who are changing habits and those who need help to understand sleep patterns.  I did think that some of the helps and stories were a bit youthful for the mature user. Many of those who are dealing with sleep issues have psychological issues. It seems to me that the program is complex enough on its own.  Also there is no way to add any sleeps to the time frames. I do not have any idea what sleep stages I am in.
There is at least one 2.5 hour nap per day in every 24 hour period for me. When my day’s summary is reported, i cannot help but feel chastised when I see that “last night’s sleep was poor.” Etc. 

So i uninstalled the whole thing. And now I find parts of the monitoring all over my phone. yipes!! I want it gone, please. Especially the “focus”time changes have been hard to remove. This may be due to overlaps from internal Apple software. 

I think you may want to do some phone interviews of users, to evaluate where to go with any revisions to the program. I myself would revisit the reading and comprehension levels of the materials used for relaxation. Remember that many, if not most, really bright folks have occasional times of low sleep. I would dramatically raise the levels and complexity of some of the readings. I would add more poetry and rhythmic speech. And expand music choices !!  This program may be a really good thing to have in one ‘s repertoire of choices. It does need, in my view, a comprehensive cleaning out of the support materials.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I have been a customer with Pillow for a few years. Then without any notification, they stopped supporting my watch, which is an apple five. Even though I’ve paid for a yearly subscription up front and I have six months or more left on my subscription they will not refund my purchase and no matter what they say. I cannot get the refund from Apple even though I have a receipt. When the app was working, it was great but beware of terrible customer service. They should be advocating and I shouldn’t have to spend so much time trying to sort this out.

reviews.title: Apple Watch and Updates

This combined with updates over the years which took many free features on the app and blocked them behind a paywall, has truly saddened me. I hope that Pillow can reflect upon itself and create a solution.

reviews.title: No record of me waking up and going to the bathroom?? App says I was in REM sleep.
reviews.text:
I have an Apple Watch 11 and am fully charged before bed. Generally, I like the Pillow app. But last night I went to the restroom three times, and Pillow only recorded me waking up twice. The middle bathroom trip was completely omitted and marked as REM sleep. How many other times has Pillow been incorrectly tracking my sleep? Me walking around my house and going to the restroom should be the easiest part of my “sleep” to track? You have one job. If you can’t do it, you’re a useless app. Don’t pay money for garbage.

I also use the built-in Apple sleep tracker and a few other sleep trackers so that I can cross reference them for accuracy. ALL other sleep trackers marked that I woke up three times, unlike Pillow.

reviews.title: Bummed that older watches are now phased out
reviews.text: I first got this app when I got my new Apple Watch in 2020. I have been a paid subscriber and using it for the gentle haptic alarm nearly every work day since then. Last night the app was uninstalled from my watch while I slept, I missed my alarm, and after some research it appears my older watch model (series 5, still going strong!) is no longer supported because it can’t update to os11 and I cannot get the app back on there. Mainly just leaving this review in case anyone else ends up experiencing this and looks at reviews to try to figure out what’s going on with their watch/app!

reviews.title: Not fully accurate
reviews.text:
Not easy to figure out either. The colors that are used to show you your sleep stages are too close in colors. I wonder why they have me asleep way longer than I was. Then why are the hours divided in half so that there are 3 times listed. I have been trying 3 and Pillow will be eliminated. It often shows disruption when I don’t believe is true. I know when I have slept like the dead,then when I have a long disruption, I sometimes get up for an hour so as not to just lay there stressing and that is not always registered. They say, can we get in touch, sure, but I haven’t seen it yet.
Test out 2 or 3 then decide, not just with results you want gpbut what is the most realistic.

reviews.title: A Great Tool for Understanding Your Sleep
reviews.text: I’ve been using the Pillow app for over two years, and it has been incredibly helpful for tracking my sleep. I especially love the snoring and sound recordings, which helped me recognize a pattern that ultimately led me to identify my sleep apnea. It also provides helpful information about my heart rate while I’m sleeping and alerts me to unusual changes. Overall, Pillow has given me a much better understanding of my sleep patterns and has been a valuable tool for monitoring my sleep health. I highly recommend it!
